rationale: Status no. The held original of EO 10955 (26 FR 6967, fr-originals text, identity checked by heading, number, date and signature) has two sections: sec. 1 delegates the functions under sections 2 and 3 of the Act of September 8, 1960 to the Secretary of State, and sec. 2 allocates the appropriated funds. Neither has an own-terms sunset. EO 10973 (3 November 1961, 26 FR 10469, official FR text) sec. 605(c) expressly supersedes Executive Order No. 10955 of July 31, 1961 without exception and sec. 607 makes it effective as of September 30, 1961; sec. 101 re-delegates the same Latin America act functions to the Secretary of State. No earlier end, no partial survival and no saved independent command: sec. 606 saves only actions already taken, and the functions continue under EO 10973. Later-source searches (US Code, eCFR, OFR catalog) found no contrary event. The first end is 1961-09-30. Observations reviewed: API:2d383bb7730585ad4805513a: OFR catalog note "Superseded by: EO 10973, November 3, 1961": agrees with the held EO 10973 text; its date is the signing date, the order itself makes the supersession effective 1961-09-30 (sec. 607). | S1989:5ad09c3bd3b604e68971f629: 1989 codification snapshot (category superseded, actor EO 10973): an editorial snapshot only, not used as a basis; consistent with the held EO 10973 text.
